_comment: System processes in plain language (plan §4a item 2). 'group' links processes that work together; 'adviceKey' points into advice.json. Unknown names are shown raw.

cloudd.name: iCloud sync (CloudKit)
cloudd.what: Syncs app data and iCloud Drive with iCloud.

bird.name: iCloud Drive
bird.what: Keeps iCloud Drive files in step with iCloud.

fileproviderd.name: Files sync
fileproviderd.what: Hands files between iCloud Drive and apps.

FileProvider.name: Files sync
FileProvider.what: Hands files between iCloud Drive and apps.

nsurlsessiond.name: Downloads
nsurlsessiond.what: Does background downloads and uploads for apps and iCloud.

healthd.name: Health
healthd.what: Stores Health data and restores it from iCloud on a new phone.

searchd.name: Search indexing
searchd.what: Builds the index that Spotlight search uses.

spotlightknowledged.name: Search indexing
spotlightknowledged.what: Builds search suggestions from your content.

mediaanalysisd.name: Photos analysis
mediaanalysisd.what: Recognises people, objects and text in your photos, mostly while charging.

photoanalysisd.name: Photos analysis
photoanalysisd.what: Builds Memories and search for Photos.

appstored.name: App Store installs
appstored.what: Downloads and installs apps and updates.

backupd.name: iCloud Backup
backupd.what: Backs the phone up to iCloud, usually overnight on Wi-Fi and power.

mobileassetd.name: System downloads
mobileassetd.what: Downloads system resources such as voices, fonts and updates.

kernel_task.name: iOS itself
kernel_task.what: The core of iOS. Its writes include work done on behalf of other processes.

locationd.name: Location
locationd.what: Works out where the phone is for apps and system features.

biomesyncd.name: On-device learning sync
biomesyncd.what: Syncs on-device usage data between your devices.

analyticsd.name: Analytics
analyticsd.what: Collects the analytics files Vitals reads (when Share iPhone Analytics is on).

amsengagementd.name: App Store services
amsengagementd.what: App Store and Apple Media Services background work.

siriactionsd.name: Siri and Shortcuts
siriactionsd.what: Indexes actions for Siri and Shortcuts.

ThreeBarsXPCService.name: Wi-Fi quality reporting
ThreeBarsXPCService.what: Reports Wi-Fi signal quality; short bursts are normal.

sysmond.name: Measurement (Mac capture)
sysmond.what: Part of the Mac capture itself, not the phone's own work.

DTServiceHub.name: Measurement (Mac capture)
DTServiceHub.what: Part of the Mac capture itself, not the phone's own work.

remotepairingdeviced.name: Mac connection
remotepairingdeviced.what: Keeps the connection to the Mac open during a capture.
